author: Gio Battaglia
title: Ontario County man charged after two snakes found dead in Geneva apartment - NewsBreak
text:
By Gio Battaglia ,
4 hours ago
ROCHESTER, N.Y. (WROC) — An Ontario County man is facing animal cruelty charges after officials said two snakes were found dead inside an apartment during an eviction.
The Ontario County Humane Society said it was called by Geneva police on Feb. 19 to assist with an animal abandonment investigation at 113 Exchange Street.
Investigators said two deceased snakes were found inside aquariums: an approximately 4-foot ball python and a 2-foot corn snake.
According to the humane society, the tenant, 26-year-old Landin J. DeCook, had not been seen at the apartment since the end of September 2025. Officials said there was no electricity, water, food or heat for the snakes.
After several unsuccessful attempts to locate DeCook, an arrest warrant was issued charging him with two counts of aggravated animal cruelty, a felony, according to the humane society.
DeCook was located Tuesday morning at a Budget Inn on Route 104 in Ontario, officials said. He was arrested and taken to the Ontario County Jail for centralized arraignment.
The Ontario County Sheriff’s Office assisted with the arrest.
